title: TM_aquisition: code for reference-less 3D vectorial transmission-matrix retrieval in multimode fibers
description: Code accompanying the manuscript "Breaking the Phase-Ambiguity Limit: Reference-less 3D Vectorial Transmission-Matrix Retrieval in Multimode Fibers". It retrieves the transmission matrix of a multimode fiber in its guided-mode basis from intensity-only measurements, without a reference beam. It includes the forward model, the joint fit and fast ADMM retrieval, the RAF21 and ADMM pixel-basis baselines, lab replay scripts and the figure scripts. The measurement data are at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24243174.
